summary: IVX Holdings autonomous conversational voice + daily self-upgrade system certified end-to-end: Voice calls are now fully CONVERSATIONAL — the caller speaks, SignalWire transcribes via Gather, the IVX AI brain (GPT-4o) answers in real-time, and loops back for follow-up questions. The daily self-upgrade scheduler runs every 24 hours automatically — reviewing the 112-agent fleet, running code execution certs, generating AI improvement plans, and notifying the owner via SMS + voice. All verified through 3 QA audit tests (IVX company questions, developer agent questions, normal questions).

conversationalVoice.description: Voice calls use SignalWire LaML <Gather> for speech recognition. When the caller speaks, SignalWire transcribes the speech and posts it to /api/ivx/signalwire/voice/respond. The backend sends the transcribed question to the IVX AI brain (GPT-4o via Vercel AI Gateway), gets a conversational answer, and returns LaML XML that says the answer then loops back to Gather for the next question. This creates a real back-and-forth conversation.
flow: 1. Call connects → SignalWire fetches /api/ivx/signalwire/voice/laml (conversational LaML with Gather)
2. Greeting: 'Hello, this is IVX Holdings autonomous assistant...'
5. Backend sends question to IVX AI brain (GPT-4o) via requestIVXAIText()
6. AI returns conversational answer (max 3 sentences, phone-friendly)
7. LaML says the answer + loops back to <Gather> for next question
8. Loop continues until caller hangs up (max 10 iterations)
